title: The Apple of My Eye

{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW The Apple of My Eye.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Juney]] |location= Rito Village |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW| * Silver Rupee }} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|The Apple of My Eye||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|The Apple of My Eye}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Rito Village}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== When [[Link]] arrives in [[Rito Village]], he can meet [[Juney]]. She is visiting Rito Village on her honeymoon, though she finds herself disappointed by the town.{{Cite|I'm here on my honeymoon. But this town is seriously a hole.|Juney|BotW}} Juney thinks she would have more fun in [[Gerudo Town]] or [[Zora's Domain]], but Rito Village makes her want to return home.{{Cite|In Gerudo Town, they've got jewelry to buy. Zora's Domain is always a hoot with all of the weird, spiritual fish people... But here...I just want to go home already.|Juney|BotW}} She is outraged that this is the place her husband, [[Jogo]], chose to visit,{{Cite|Give me a break already! I can't believe my husband brought me here for our honeymoon...|Juney|BotW}} and she threatened him with a divorce unless he brought her a [[Baked Apple]].{{Cite|He already apologized, but if he doesn't want a divorce, I told him he'd better bring me a {{Color BotW|Blue|baked apple}}.|Juney|BotW}} Once Link hears this, the [[Side Quest]] begins. In order to help ease Juney's bad mood, Link must bring her a Baked Apple.{{Cite|Distracting her from her troubles with a {{Color BotW|Red|baked apple}}, her favorite snack, is one way to lighten the mood.

Bring Juney a {{Color BotW|Red|baked apple}} and save her marriage!|Adventure Log|BotW}} They can be made by dropping an [[Apple]] next to a [[Fire]] or in a [[Scorching Climate]]. Once Link has one, Juney will be able to smell it on him.{{Cite|*sniff sniff*
I know that smell! You've got a {{Color BotW|Blue|baked apple}}!|Juney|BotW}} She asks for it, promising a present in return.{{Cite|Can I have {{Color BotW|Blue|one}}? I'll give you a present!|Juney|BotW}} If Link gives it to Juney, she will gift him a [[Silver Rupee]].{{Cite|[Sure thing.] You serious? Cheers! Just hold out your hand.|Juney|BotW}} Though she wishes her husband would be the one to bring her Baked Apples,{{Cite|Now if I could only get my husband to cook me a {{Color BotW|Blue|baked apple}} every once in a while.|Juney|BotW}} she asks Link to bring her more in the future.{{Cite|I've got a second stomach and a hollow leg for {{Color BotW|Blue|baked apples}}. Bring me as many as you possibly can.|Juney|BotW}} With this, the Side Quest will be complete. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Juney, currently in Rito Village on her honeymoon, is about to blow her stack if she can't find what she's looking for.

Distracting her from her troubles with a {{Color BotW|Red|baked apple}}, her favorite snack, is one way to lighten the mood.

Bring Juney a {{Color BotW|Red|baked apple}} and save her marriage! |- | Complete | You gave Juney, currently honeymooning in Rito Village, a baked apple. She was so grateful that she paid you a few rupees for the service.

Juney told you that she'll never turn down a {{Color BotW|Red|baked apple}}. If you gather any more, bring them directly to her! }} ==Trivia== * In {{AoC}}, both "The Apple of My Eye" and "[[The Spark of Romance]]" are referenced by the "[[Soured Honeymoon]]" [[Quest]]. As part of this Quest, a husband wants to give his wife her favorite [[Wildberry|Wildberries]] to apologize after fighting on their honeymoon.{{Cite|A husband confides that he and his wife got into an argument during their honeymoon. To help him show how deeply he values their union, gather some of his wife's favorite berries.|Gallery (Interface)|AoC}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Juney * Rito Village * The Spark of Romance }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
